verses.20:124: وَمَنۡ أَعۡرَضَ عَن ذِكۡرِي فَإِنَّ لَهُۥ مَعِيشَةࣰ ضَنكࣰ ا وَنَحۡشُرُهُۥ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ أَعۡمَىٰ

meaning: The root ضنك (Dnk) primarily signifies narrowness, straitness, and hardship. It describes anything narrow or strait, like a place or a difficult life.
en_note: Manually curated for a Quranic hapax root.
